input: Set up a bird feeder in the backyard

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Bird Feeder in the Backyard
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to set up a bird feeder in their backyard, from choosing the right feeder to installing and maintaining it.

questions.title: Do you already own a feeder, or need to buy one?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs to research and purchase a bird feeder or already has one ready to install.

questions.title: What types of birds are you hoping to attract?
questions.description: Identify the target bird species, as this affects feeder type, seed choice, and placement height.

questions.title: How will the feeder be mounted or hung?
questions.description: Clarify the intended installation method — hanging from a tree branch, pole-mounted in the ground, or attached to a fence or wall.

questions.title: Are there squirrels or other animals to deter?
questions.description: Understand whether pest deterrents such as baffles, caged feeders, or specific pole placements need to be factored into the plan.

questions.title: Do you have a specific spot in the backyard in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has already chosen a location or needs guidance on ideal placement relative to trees, windows, and open space.

questions.title: What is your budget for this setup?
questions.description: Establish a budget range to guide recommendations for feeder type, mounting hardware, seed, and any accessories.

questions.title: When are you planning to have this completed?
questions.description: Determine the user's timeline or deadline so the task plan can be scoped and prioritized appropriately.
